title: Foxxy's Craftable Sherds
description: A small datapack that allows you to craft pottery sherds!
body:
# Info
### Version 1.1.0 is out now!
- Updated to more modern versions
- Recipes can be unlocked in the recipe book
- Changes to existing recipes
- Removed sherd duplication from this datapack
- Grouped together Sherd recipes to declutter the recipe book

### About the datapack

This is an extension of Foxxy's Dupable Sherds, found here: https://modrinth.com/datapack/foxxys_dupable_sherds

Pottery Sherds can be crafted with 7 bricks, a diamond, and a special item that makes each sherd unique to the others. Below is a list of sherds with their corresponding special item:

Angler -> Fishing Rod

Archer -> Bow

Arms Up -> Crossbow

Blade -> Iron, Diamond, or Netherite Sword

Brewer -> Any type of Potion, Splash Potion, or Lingering Potion

Burn -> Flint & Steel, Coal, Charcoal, or a lava bucket

Danger -> Creeper Head

Explorer -> Map

Flow -> Wind Charge

Friend -> Emerald

Guster -> Breeze Rod

Heart -> Heart of the Sea

Heartbreak -> Creaking Heart

Howl -> Wolf Armour

Miner -> Iron, Diamond, or Netherite Pickaxe

Mourner -> Sculk Catalyst

Plenty -> Chest or a Trapped Chest

Prize -> Gold Block, Emerald Block, Diamond Block, or Netherite Block

Scrape -> Iron, Diamond, or Netherite Axe

Sheaf -> Wheat

Shelter -> All types of Overworld Sapling

Skull -> Skeleton or Wither Skeleton Skull

Snort -> Torchflower or Pitcher Plant



Note that:
- All ingredients are consumed when crafted. Do not lose your maxed netherite pickaxe to a pottery sherd!
- As of Datapack Version 1.1.0, sherd duping is not supported in this datapack. To restore this functionality, check out my datapack designed with this idea in mind: https://modrinth.com/datapack/foxxys_dupable_sherds
